lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: The follow-up codex-adapter implementation issue still needs to pick between the two ADR-0047-recorded directions for the claude-transcript-coupled token-ceiling backstop (loop.ts:1189): a codex transcript equivalent for readWorkerTokens, or documented graceful degradation.

readBackend's upgrade from a single top-level key to a per-phase accessor (mirroring readPhaseModel) is decided in ADR-0047 but not implemented; the implementation issue must also decide the backward-compat shape for existing single-key project.toml files.
nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 was a mechanical review-round-1 fix: ADR-0047 had 8 em-dash (U+2014) characters (lines 14, 34, 38, 40, 47, 51, 55; line 38 carried two) violating the no-em-dash-in-persisted-.md project convention (patterns.md line 24). Replaced each with a colon, comma, semicolon, or plain period per surrounding sentence structure; no content/meaning changed, purely punctuation. Verified via `grep -n $'\xe2\x80\x94' <file>` returning zero matches post-fix. No code touched, no adapter/backend logic changed. Full quality spine (`bun run check:all`) green: 5017 tests pass, typecheck clean, lint/coverage/dead-code/dup/file-size/debt-markers/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok.
